fact: A HISP evaluation in the last quarter of 2021 found that facilities send their monthly reports on paper to the health zone office, where they are entered into the national DHIS2 (SNIS); facility-level entry exists only in some large facilities with power and internet, and a MEASURE Evaluation project that had funded laptops and internet for facility entry in 63 facilities in Kikula and Kapolowe ran about two years before funding stopped and the devices deteriorated.
title: Supporting effective health data use in the Democratic Republic of the Congo with DHIS2
